Card Q&A.q: When I activate EX9-070 [Meat]'s  effect and would digivolve my Digimon into this card with the digivolution cost reduced by 2, can I activate this card's 1st effect and further reduce the digivolution cost by 1 for each of that Digimon's face-down digivolution cards?

Effect: When any of your [Ver.2] trait Digimon would digivolve into this card, for each of its face-down digivolution cards, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, return 1 of your opponent's play cost 4 or lower Digimon or Tamers to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
